name: heart
description: A balanced heart with full lobes and a softened lower point.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: The lower contour forms a slim V: mirrored straight 45-degree flanks meet through one small convex quadratic tip. Side curves join the straight flanks tangentially, without inward inflections or a broad lower belly. The current upper lobes and notch are retained. Outline bounds x=3.25..20.75, y=4.1..19.9 remain centered. Review study; not owner-approved.
